messages:
deploy-bot: rolling out r2026.03.20 -> hosted + dedicated-eu-west at 15% traffic. Observability spike: p95 +40% on dedicated pool d-eu-west-1. rollback_thresholds: p95>300ms && errors>0.5% for 3m. Suggested action: evaluate.

Maya (release-lead): copying. hold traffic shift? i don't want a full abort without quick check.

Jon (oncall-sre): seeing increased KV cache churn on the dedicated hosts, correlates with a model change in runtime v2.5.9. error spike is 502s from model grpc timeouts. most affected: reserved customers in eu-west. p99 also elevated.

Priya (eng-platform): can we route dedicated-eu-west to a fallback model variant (v2.5.8-quant) while we investigate? that avoids a full rollback for hosted.

Oscar (infra): routing policy already supports model-fallback by tag. i can flip routing for d-eu-west pool to fallback in ~90s, manual step.

Maya (release-lead): agree with targeted rollback/fallback for dedicated only. we should not disturb hosted if stable. Jon, can you confirm impact window and exec plan?

Jon (oncall-sre): impact window: last 7m. customers seeing API 502s and timeouts. plan: 1) flip routing to fallback model for d-eu-west 2) if errors persist after 3m, run manual rollback of runtime to v2.5.8 for dedicated pool. i'll run step 1 now and monitor.

deploy-bot: action accepted. executing routing-change job: route-change/2123456789 -> target: model:v2.5.8-quant scope:dedicated-eu-west. estimated completion: 90s.

Maya (release-lead): @Lena pls prep short customer note if this becomes a rollback. minimal comms: what changed, who impacted, ETA for full rollback.

Lena (product): on it. draft will likely say: "temporary routing to fallback model for dedicated-eu-west due to increased timeouts; no data loss; expected restoration within ~10-30m; teams are investigating." will post draft in #customer-notify.

Jon (oncall-sre): routing flip complete. immediate drop in 502s, p95 back down ~20%. continuing to watch for 3m.

Priya (eng-platform): nice. can we add automated monitor to pause rollout if p95 goes >250ms again? we should tighten thresholds.

Maya (release-lead): yes, add a temporary stricter threshold for this rollout. Oscar, can you update deploy policy so automated rollback triggers at p95>250ms for 2m for dedicated pools?

Oscar (infra): will do. setting temp-policy: rollout/2123456789 -> auto-rollback p95>250ms for 2m on dedicated pools.

ReleaseNotesBot: new note created: "r2026.03.20 - ephemeral routing fallback applied to dedicated-eu-west for stability; monitoring and rollback policies adjusted."

Jon (oncall-sre): monitoring window passed 12m, traffic stable, no further 502s. Recommend we continue cautious rollout to 50% over next hour.

Maya (release-lead): proceed to 50%. keep dedicated fallback enabled until full stability for 1h. please log exact timing commands in the deploy-runbook so we can audit.

deploy-bot: proceeding to 50% per release-lead. next check at +30m.

Lena (product): customer note posted to draft; will send to impacted accounts if rollback executed.

Jon (oncall-sre): quick note for postmortem: root cause likely model runtime change interacting with KV eviction thresholds; add regression test for KV-heavy workloads.

Maya (release-lead): agreed. schedule 1:1 postmortem tomorrow 10:30am. action items: Priya/Oscar/Jon to investigate kernel change, regression tests, and deploy policy improvements.

Priya (eng-platform): added to my board. creating ticket ENG-4821: "regression test: kv-heavy bursts + runtime v2.5.x".

Oscar (infra): also adding infra mitigation: enable automatic fallback by default for dedicated pools until we finish the regression.

deploy-bot: update: rollout at 50% complete, dedicated-eu-west still on fallback model, no rollback executed. thread closed after monitoring window. :white_check_mark:

Maya (release-lead): thanks all, good run. we'll follow up in the postmortem. :thumbsup:
